question:

Then, Fred and Dave swap balls. Then, Eve and Alice swap balls. Finally, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) green ball
(B) brown ball
(C) purple ball
(D) pink ball
(E) white ball
(F) red ball
(G) orange ball
